invariants.rationale: The method always returns a BulkInsertPartitioner instance; neither code path returns null.
strategyParams is used without null checks and is expected to be non-null by contract.
schema is used for further method calls (HoodieSchemaUtils.addMetadataFields) and must not be null.
The result is always a BulkInsertPartitioner instance constructed from the two branches.
This tautology expresses completeness of the two return branches.
